name: Hope Harbor
description: Community nonprofit template for a food bank & youth charity with count-up impact stats, a wave-filled appeal bar and a donation chooser.
features: Impact counters that count up when scrolled into view
Appeal progress bar that fills with an animated wave
Donation chooser with one-off/monthly toggle, preset and custom amounts and live impact text
Programme cards, priced gift options, stories, volunteer sign-up and contact form
signature: Impact numbers count up and the appeal goal bar fills with a rolling wave when in view; amount buttons update the donate button live
